verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an official CLI for managing flags, segments, projects and environments from the terminal and for evaluating flags. It also offers an Admin API covering everything the dashboard can do, and a Docker setup that runs a full environment locally. Together these clearly enable headless, scripted automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g. a CI action or pipeline examples, or non-interactive auth guidance for CI), a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
